scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && vite build && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.build:firefox: npm run build:wasm && TARGET_BROWSER=firefox vite build && TARGET_BROWSER=firefox node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.test:scripts: node scripts/publish-edge.test.mjs && node scripts/publish-chrome.test.mjs && node scripts/sync-amo-listing.test.mjs && node scripts/fit-name.test.mjs
